newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid cargo volume was 14 pct higher in November.
newsitem.headline: Madrid cargo volume was 14 pct higher in November.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Madrid's Barajas airport rose 14.0 percent in November to 22,432 tonnes, compared with the same month last year and following a six percent fall in October, the airport authority said.
The accumulated total is now 3.7 percent ahead of 1995 at 216,677 tonnes, with domestic traffic up 5.7 percent and international traffic only 2.8 percent higher.

Passenger numbers rose 17.6 percent in November to 1.72 million and the number of air transport movements increased 25.3 percent to 21,258. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
